Interface GTNetMaintenanceWindowJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<GTNetMaintenanceWindow, Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<GTNetMaintenanceWindow, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<GTNetMaintenanceWindow, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<GTNetMaintenanceWindow, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<GTNetMaintenanceWindow, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<GTNetMaintenanceWindow>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<GTNetMaintenanceWindow, Integer>
public interface GTNetMaintenanceWindowJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<GTNetMaintenanceWindow, Integer>
Repository for the announced maintenance windows of remote GTNet instances.

A window is never turned into a persisted server state. The two findIdGtNetIn… queries are the live evaluation every caller uses before contacting a peer, and they are deliberately answered in one statement for all peers at once, because the delivery and broadcast tasks iterate over the whole peer list.

    • findByIdGtNetAndFromDateTimeAndToDateTime

      Optional<GTNetMaintenanceWindow> findByIdGtNetAndFromDateTimeAndToDateTime(Integer idGtNet, LocalDateTime fromDateTime, LocalDateTime toDateTime)
      Looks a window up by its natural key, so that a re-delivered announcement updates the existing row instead of adding a duplicate. The same triple carries the unique constraint of the table.
      Parameters:
      idGtNet - the remote GTNet ID
      fromDateTime - start of the window
      toDateTime - end of the window
      Returns:
      the matching window, if one exists

    • findIdGtNetInMaintenance

      @Query("SELECT DISTINCT w.idGtNet FROM GTNetMaintenanceWindow w WHERE w.fromDateTime <= ?1 AND w.toDateTime >= ?1") List<Integer> findIdGtNetInMaintenance(LocalDateTime now)
      The IDs of all remotes that are inside one of their announced maintenance windows right now. Callers use it as an exclusion set rather than asking per peer.
      Parameters:
      now - the moment to test, normally LocalDateTime.now()
      Returns:
      the IDs of the remotes currently under maintenance, empty when none is

    • countPerGtNet

      @Query("SELECT w.idGtNet, COUNT(w) FROM GTNetMaintenanceWindow w GROUP BY w.idGtNet") List<Object[]> countPerGtNet()
      Counts the announced windows per remote, for the header of the maintenance panel. The count includes windows that have already passed, because they stay visible until their announcement is deleted.
      Returns:
      one row per remote that has at least one window, [idGtNet, count]
